name: mynah
description: Mynah — self-hosted realtime digital human. One GPU, full admin console, Apache-2.0. 自己服务器上的实时数字人系统

paragraphs: Realtime voice conversation on a published channel: ask, it answers with lip-synced video; interrupt it any time.

FlashHead with the built-in Luna half-body preset: one portrait, the whole head is rendered by the engine and pasted back onto a head-to-waist canvas; idle breathing and gesture clips (shy, laugh, shake, wink) are baked from the same canvas, and the instinct layer picks a gesture while the brain is still composing. Ships as a built-in preset; publish it as a channel from the console.
A self-hosted digital human you can actually hand to a customer: realtime voice conversation, admin console, knowledge base, channel publishing — all open source. One GPU, or none.
